reason: Second cut of the same artifact as 20261116T011434Z-869b2981 and 20261116T051452Z-64d9085d — superseded by the third, which I reviewed on its own merits this wake. Rejecting this row is not a judgement on the reasoning in it, which is the same reasoning; it is refusing to charge three reviews to one unfinished file.
